Passive.Name: Speedy Delivery
Passive.Desc: At the End of Scene. At 10+ Courier Trunk, gain 1 Haste. At 20+ Courier Trunk, gain 1 Strength and 2 Haste. At 30 Courier Trunk, gain 2 Strength and 2 Haste

Passive.Name: Restoration Core
Passive.Desc: Upon taking what would be a lethal blow, nullify all incoming damage including what activated this passive, fully recover HP and move to next Phase (Max Phase: 3); at the end of the Scene this happens, fully restore Stagger Resist, Light and Draw 1 page. Unique BGM included.

Passive.Name: Phases
Passive.Desc: Phase 2 and Phase 3; 50% more Hp and Break. Has unique EGO pages and BGM.

Passive.Name: Blessing of the Light
Passive.Desc: At the start of each Scene, fully restore Light at a 50% chance

Passive.Name: Let's Get Fired Up
Passive.Desc: After dealing 10 or higher total damage in a Scene, restore 3 Light.

Passive.Name: Static Regeneration
Passive.Desc: If the character was not hit by any attacks for a Scene, recover 30 HP, 30 Stagger Resist and gain 3 Strength.

Passive.Name: HunterHax’s Prowess
Passive.Desc: When using a Combat Page, all dice on the page gain Power against targets with slower Speed. (+1 Power per 2 points of difference, up to 6)

Passive.Name: Barrier
Passive.Desc: Takes 50% less damage from all Ranged attacks. Reflects all Ranged attacks

Passive.Name: Counter Attack
Passive.Desc: Gain a Counter die with [On Hit] 50% chance to inflict 1 Strong Seal (Slash, 4-8) at combat start.

Passive.Name: Soul Harvester
Passive.Desc: Recover 25% HP and Stagger Resist upon defeating an enemy.
